posts.title: your hand on someone else's heartbeat
posts.description: When my husband was in the late stages of his terminal illness, he asked me to read him poetry. He didn't ask for short stories, or essays, or news articles, or the first crisp pages of a novel, with its unfolding narrative weight. The request was unexpected. posts.title: the 2025 roll of nickels year in review
posts.description: 2025 was a very quiet year here at Roll of Nickels, as life and work demands derailed my grand ambitions. I only managed to post five quotes on writing , and archive three of my favourite pieces of critical prose that I've written in recent years: an essay on poetry and companionship ; my companion piece to my book Weather , " Some Notes on Writing Haiku "; and my recent interview with Ben Robinso
